text:
Mara (PM): quick sync — we need a compact checklist and owner matrix for the 'Optimizer' feature before we sign commercial terms. items: SLO commitment, runbook, billing metric mapping, docs, pricing page blurb, oncall. who can own which?
AJ (Eng): I can own the SLO language and perf targets. thinking P95 <= 120ms for simple routes, burst p99 fallback plan. need SRE input for feasibility.
Devin (SRE): P95 120ms sounds plausible on dedicated infra. question: do we commit to regional fallbacks? also need an autoscale playbook and a throttling policy. I'll draft runbook snippets.
Priya (Docs): I'll take the user-facing guides and the quickstart. need final API shape + example responses — can someone confirm the response schema for the streaming vs non-streaming paths?
AJ (Eng): streaming has fields: "streaming": true, chunks in order; non-streaming returns full "output" array. I'll paste snippet soon.
Mara (PM): @Lucas, commercial wants a short blurb for pricing pages and any usage caveats (burst billing). Lucas?
Lucas (Sales): happy to draft the blurb. Need clarity on unit: tokens vs inference-requests for this feature. prefer tokens if we can surface cost per 1k tokens. Also flag enterprise reserved capacity discounts.
Devin (SRE): ops questions: oncall rotation — do we add this to infra oncall or product infra? I'd prefer infra oncall for first 90d. also need routing policy: route->dedicated pool, fallback->hosted-l1.
Mara (PM): agreement: infra oncall first 90d. AJ, can you add fallback policy to the prod config and call out required metrics?
AJ (Eng): will do. metrics I plan to emit: request_latency_ms (p50/p95/p99), queued_requests, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_version. Also add a counter for degraded_fallbacks.
Priya (Docs): for runbook I'll need expected alert thresholds. Devin, can you suggest thresholds for P95 and error-rate?
Devin (SRE): propose: page if p95 > 250ms for 5m or error_rate > 1% for 5m. warning if p95 > 150ms for 10m. logging: include request_id and model_version in all errors.
Mara (PM): good. need a small acceptance note for product review: "no undocumented breaking changes, performance within targets, docs and pricing draft, and oncall assigned." Who volunteers to own acceptance check?
Lucas (Sales): I'll own commercial acceptance and confirm pricing language with legal.
AJ (Eng): I'll own the product-performance acceptance.
Priya (Docs): Docs acceptance on me. will link PRs here when ready.
Devin (SRE): Ops acceptance on me — will attach runbook and alerting config.
Mara (PM): timeline: aim to have all owners sign off by end of next week (7 days). small blockers?
AJ (Eng): blocker: need confirmation on model quantization profile to finalize perf numbers. pinging eng-ml separately.
Devin (SRE): blocker: capacity estimate for reserved customers — need finops input to compute burst cost. @Lucas can you loop in finops?
Lucas (Sales): yep I'll loop in FinOps and Finance.
ops-bot: reminder — weekly readiness review meeting scheduled Wed 15:00 UTC. Please attach docs before Tue EOD. :bell:
Mara (PM): summary of owners -> AJ: perf & API shape, Devin: runbook & alerts, Priya: docs, Lucas: commercial/pricing, Mara: overall signoff. I'll convert this into a tiny owner spreadsheet and share. thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya (Docs): quick note on examples — I'll include a short troubleshooting section with the common error codes and suggestions. can someone share the exact error keys we emit?
AJ (Eng): errors: rate_limited, model_unavailable, fallback_served, invalid_input. will add to spec.
Devin (SRE): also include 'kv_cache_miss' for debugging slow warmups.
Mara (PM): perfect. next actions: owners add their check items as comments in the owner sheet, link PRs and runbook GDoc. close loop by next Wed review.
Lucas (Sales): ack, I'll draft the pricing blurb and share Monday.
AJ (Eng): starting API gist now.
Priya (Docs): adding placeholders and will iterate.
Devin (SRE): drafting runbook, will call out paging rules.
Mara (PM): thanks team — tagging this thread for traceability. if anything slips, escalate in #release-war-room.
